capabilities: Scan notes, canvases, frontmatter and HTML for attachment links
List unused attachments with path and size, largest first
Move selected files to trash or an archive folder after confirmation
Find files with identical content and merge duplicates
Repoint links to the kept copy and undo the last merge
extras: Runs entirely locally with no network requests. Installation instructions cover manual copying only. Undo of a duplicate merge leaves alone any note edited after the merge.
problem: Vaults collect attachments that no note links to and identical files saved under different names, and Obsidian offers no way to find them or see the space they take.

relations.evidence: Covers links built by plugins: Dataview, Templater and similar plugins can build a link
Covers links built by plugins: Dataview, Templater and similar plugins can build a link

summary: Finds unused and duplicate attachments, shows their sizes, and moves the ones you pick to trash or an archive folder, with undo for merges.
